title: ID0441685-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / RN 170002845] Charging point crashed
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  First, one charging point crashed on July 30th, and then all of them
crashed. We tried to restart the box with a hard reset, but
unfortunately, that didn't work.
